lines.text: Two giants plan to spend up to $425 billion.
lines.say: Two giants plan to spend up to four hundred twenty-five billion dollars.

lines.text: That's Alphabet's and Amazon's plans for 2026, and both raised them in July.
lines.say: That's Alphabet's and Amazon's plans for twenty twenty-six, and both raised them in July.

lines.text: From April through June alone, Alphabet spent $44.9 billion, about double a year earlier.
lines.say: From April through June alone, Alphabet spent forty-four point nine billion dollars, about double a year earlier.

lines.text: Microsoft spent $41 billion in its quarter ending in June, about two-thirds on chips and similar gear.
lines.say: Microsoft spent forty-one billion dollars in its quarter ending in June, about two-thirds on chips and similar gear.

lines.text: And Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says even $220 billion won't buy enough capacity.
lines.say: And Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says even two hundred twenty billion won't buy enough capacity.

scene.text: Even at that amount, we will still not have enough capacity to meet all the demand we have in 2026.

lines.text: Why care? If you own an S&P 500 index fund, you own a slice of all three.
lines.say: Why care? If you own an S and P five hundred index fund, you own a slice of all three.

lines.text: Microsoft and Alphabet report results on Wednesday, October 28, and Amazon reports on Thursday, October 29.
lines.say: Microsoft and Alphabet report results on Wednesday, October twenty-eighth, and Amazon reports on Thursday, October twenty-ninth.

lines.text: Investors are watching two things: the spending plans, and whether all that money is paying off yet.

post.title: Two tech giants plan to spend up to $425 billion in 2026
post.ig:
Two tech giants plan to spend up to $425 billion in 2026.
Alphabet raised its 2026 capital spending plan to $195-$205 billion; Amazon raised its to about $220 billion (July 2026).
Alphabet spent $44.9 billion in Q2 2026, about double a year earlier. Microsoft spent $41 billion in its June quarter.
Microsoft and Alphabet report Oct 28; Amazon reports Oct 29.
Sources: Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft June-quarter reports; company releases.
News and education, not financial advice.
